issue.standard_remedy: Qualify a second source and shift volume
issue.summary: High-risk supplier (score 53.1) holds 11% of a category

plan.diagnosis: Lombard Continental Chemicals Inc. represents USD 97,950 in spend (11.5% category share) with a high risk score of 53.1 driven by poor resiliency (39) and ESG performance (43), plus failure class 3. The concentration creates single-source vulnerability in a critical chemical category with an at-risk supplier.

remedy_steps.step: Launch RFI to identify and pre-qualify minimum two alternative chemical suppliers with risk scores below 40 and resiliency above 60
Negotiate trial orders with top 2 qualified alternatives covering 30% of current Lombard volume (USD 29,385) to validate quality and delivery performance
Execute dual-source strategy shifting 50% of spend (USD 48,975) to best-performing alternative supplier while maintaining Lombard at reduced 5-6% category share
Implement quarterly risk monitoring for Lombard with automatic escalation if risk score exceeds 60 or resiliency falls below 35

plan.expected_impact: De-risk USD 48,975 of chemical spend by reducing exposure to a failure class 3 supplier and improving category resilience through dual sourcing
kpis: Lombard category share reduced from 11.5% to ≤6% within 90 days
Weighted average supplier risk score for chemical category below 45
Minimum 2 active suppliers covering 70% of chemical category spend
Zero supply disruptions during transition period
risks: Quality variation during supplier transition may impact production specifications
Lombard price increase or service degradation if they perceive volume reduction
Extended qualification timeline if alternative suppliers lack required certifications
Spot market exposure if both incumbent and new supplier fail simultaneously
erp_actions: SAP: Update source list (ME01) to add new qualified supplier(s) with quota arrangement splitting volume 50/50
SAP: Set purchasing value limit in supplier master (XK02) capping Lombard POs at USD 8,163 monthly (USD 97,950/12)
Coupa: Create preferred supplier rules routing chemical requisitions to new dual-source pool with Lombard as secondary
Oracle EBS: Update approved supplier list (ASL) adding new sources with rank 1, demote Lombard to rank 2
Dynamics 365: Configure purchase agreement with volume commitment caps for Lombard at 50% of baseline
NetSuite: Enable supplier risk alert workflow triggering approval requirement for Lombard POs over USD 5,000
